verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform, so scheduling recurring work is a fair question for it. The only relevant evidence is that merchants and ISVs can view and manage subscriptions in the Dashboard, which implies recurring billing but is a single thin mention. Webhooks and API batch closing are event-driven or manual, not scheduled. Missing for 10: general job/workflow scheduling (cron-style or recurring triggers), documented API for creating recurring schedules, details on subscription interval configuration, independent corroboration.
